home.title: Kinlock
home.heroHeadline: Money that can only reach the school or landlord it was meant for.
home.heroSubtext: Lock USDC on Stellar for a verified school or landlord, anywhere in the world. Nothing else can reach it.
home.lockBody: You lock USDC for a verified school or landlord. The payout address is fixed at that moment. Nobody can redirect it later.
home.claimBody: The payee claims it directly, on the schedule you set. No one else, including Kinlock, can touch it.
home.verifyBody: Anyone can check the payment on chain. The receipt says exactly one thing: payment to verified payee.
home.sendersBody: Pay a school or landlord for someone else, anywhere. Set a schedule instead of one lump sum, and get a receipt you can check yourself.
home.payeesBody: Get verified once, then receive payments directly, without a bank account in the sender's country. Decline any payment before you claim it.
home.nonCustodialBody: Kinlock never holds funds or keys. The contract does, and only the contract's rules decide where they go.
home.chainTruthBody: Every claim, decline, and refund is a transaction you can look up yourself, not just a row in our database.
home.honestReceiptsBody: A receipt proves a payment reached a verified payee. It isn't proof the money was spent the way anyone expected.
home.worldwideBody: Built to work the same way everywhere. A country is data the system reads, not a special case in the code.
home.footerDisclaimer: Early, unaudited software on Stellar testnet. Don't rely on it for anything real yet.

request.title: Create a payment request
request.intro: Create a link that fills in the sender's form with your details, the amount and the payment schedule.
request.noAuthority: The link only fills in the form. It can't move money: the sender still reviews and signs everything.
request.payeeNone: No verified payees are available right now.
request.indexerDown: The list of payees can't be loaded right now. Try again in a minute.
request.referenceHint: For example an invoice or student number. Anyone with this link can see it; on chain it is stored only as a hash.
request.errorAmount: Check the amounts: use numbers like 150 or 150.25, with at most 7 decimals.
request.errorDate: Choose a date for every payment.
request.errorOrder: Payments must be in date order.
request.errorGeneric: The link couldn't be created. Check the details and try again.

send.title: Send a locked payment
send.intro: Lock USDC for a verified school or landlord. It can only be paid to them, or come back to you.
send.prefilled: Filled in from a payment request. Check everything before sending: the request can't move money.
send.prefillUnknownPayee: The payee in this request isn't available right now (not verified or not active). Don't send until you've checked with them.
send.payeeNone: No verified payees are available right now.
send.indexerDown: The list of payees can't be loaded right now. Try again in a minute.
send.referenceHint: For example an invoice or student number. Only you and whoever you give the claim link to can see it; on chain it is stored as a hash.
send.expiryLabel: If unclaimed, you can take it back from (UTC date)
send.expiryHint: Must be at least an hour from now and at most 149 days.
send.blocked: This payment can't be sent until the problem above is fixed.
send.acknowledge: I've read the warnings above and want to send anyway.
send.doneShare: Send this link to the payee so they can claim. It's saved only in this browser (below); export it so you don't lose it.
send.doneNotSaved: This browser couldn't save the link. Copy it now and keep it yourself: Kinlock has no copy.
send.errorDate: Choose a date for every payment and for when it can be taken back.
send.errorAmount: Check the amounts: use numbers like 150 or 150.25, with at most 7 decimals.
send.errorMinimum: The total must be at least 1 USDC.
send.errorOrder: Payments must be in date order.
send.errorUnlockAfterExpiry: Every payment must be claimable before the date you can take it back.
send.errorExpirySoon: The take-back date must be at least an hour from now.
send.errorExpiryFar: The take-back date can be at most 149 days from now.
send.errorTx: The transaction didn't go through (it may have been declined in your wallet). Nothing was sent; you can try again.
send.errorContract: The blockchain refused this payment. Nothing was sent.
send.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Nothing was sent; you can try again.
